headline: Newark is lagging under low clouds; the other hubs are running normally.

items.text: A ground delay program is holding flights into Newark because of low clouds, until 11:59 PM ET. Delays average 105 minutes, up to 214 minutes.
Newark (EWR) has 67% of departures leaving within 30 minutes of schedule so far today (250 departed), the lowest of the seven United hubs reporting.
The other hubs are running normally.

traveler_note.text: If you are flying to Newark, check your flight status before leaving for the airport.
